entities.summary: Alexander Claudio is a Puerto Rican professional baseball pitcher for the Saraperos de Saltillo of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Texas Rangers, Milwaukee Brewers, Los Angeles Angels, and New York Mets. Claudio pitches in an unorthodox sidearm manner.
